STEP 1 - Scene: A small plated side dish of kimchi (napa cabbage in red chili paste) with a cluster of black olives, on a white plate. No other food is on the plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square dinner-style plate, about 26 cm across, so area is roughly 530 cm² (treated as round for the estimate).

STEP 3 - Items:
- Kimchi (cabbage, chili-coated, a few pieces)
- Black olives (about 10, small, pitted)
- Trace green herb bits (negligible)

STEP 4 - Area:
- Kimchi: about 12% of the plate (about 64 cm²)
- Olives: about 9% (about 50 cm²)
- Total covered: about 21%, so the food covers a small share of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Kimchi: 64 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Olives: 50 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 60 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Kimchi: 96 ml × 0.6 ≈ 58 g
- Olives: 60 ml × 0.9 ≈ 54 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Kimchi: 58 g × 20 kcal/100 g ≈ 12 kcal
- Olives: 54 g × 120 kcal/100 g ≈ 65 kcal
- Total ≈ 112 g, ≈ 77 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 10 olives and a modest portion of kimchi is plausible at roughly 110 g and under 100 kcal. Olives dominate the energy because of their fat content.
